changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]New: play NZBs with Easynews (no debrid needed)[/COLOR]
-Your Easynews account is also a Usenet server. NZBs found by your own indexer (NZBGeek or any Newznab indexer) now play straight from Easynews: playback starts in seconds and you can skip forward and back, with nothing downloaded to a debrid cloud first.
-Only the part you are watching is fetched, about 12 MB ahead, with at most about 36 MB in memory whatever the size of the release. Nothing is saved on your device.
-Plays releases with an MKV, MP4, AVI or TS file and releases packed in RAR without compression (RAR4 and RAR5, from one to hundreds of volumes, also with scrambled file names). Extra or foreign files mixed in among the volumes are found and skipped.
-Cannot be streamed: compressed or password-protected RAR, 7z, full Blu-ray discs (COMPLETE BLURAY, BDMV, ISO) and damaged posts with a missing RAR volume. They go to Premiumize or TorBox when one is on; otherwise you are told why and they are hidden.
-Uses the Easynews username and password under Accounts. Your plan must include newsreader (NNTP) access.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: availability check on Easynews[/COLOR]
-Before listing, NZB results are checked on Easynews without downloading anything, best quality first, until 8 good ones are found or the limit is reached (20 by default). Releases that were taken down are hidden.
-Checked releases show EN OK next to their size and are listed as CACHED USENET. Partly gone releases show the percentage left, such as EN 92%. Unchecked releases show EN ?. When half or more of what was checked for a title is gone, the unchecked ones are hidden too.
-Each check looks at 40 points spread over the whole file. A release found to be gone, incomplete (3% or more missing) or unplayable when you play it stops with a notice and is hidden from your next searches.
-Each check downloads the NZB once, which counts as one grab on your indexer. Results are remembered for 12 hours, removed releases for 24 hours.
[COLOR fffdb515]Custom Usenet (NZB): a switch for each service[/COLOR]
-"Download NZBs with" is replaced by one switch per service: 1. Easynews, 2. Premiumize, 3. TorBox (Pro plan). All are on by default and used only when set up, in that order; the next one takes over if one cannot play a release.
-Easynews options: server (Europe or USA), SSL port (563 or 443) and connections (4 by default). Test Easynews Usenet (NNTP) connection checks the login, a real article lookup and the playback engine.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes: setup wizards and NZB downloads[/COLOR]
-The setup pages you open from a phone or PC (Newznab, AIOStreams, Comet, Meteor, Sootio, Torz, MDBList and Badges) now answer at once instead of waiting 5 seconds for each spare connection the browser opens.
-NZB files from the indexer are only fetched over http/https and NZBs that declare XML entities are refused.
